text: The Heart of Racing racing team receives backing through video game magnate Gabe Newell, who founded the team in 2014.
short: Gabe Newell backs The Heart of Racing

source.name: Sportscar365: Heart of Racing to Run Valkyrie in IMSA, WEC in 2025
source.quote: The team receives backing through video game magnate Gabe Newell, who founded Heart of Racing in 2014

additionalSources.name: Aston Martin media: Aston Martin returns to Le Mans to fight for overall victory with Valkyrie hypercar
additionalSources.quote: Founded in 2014 by American businessman and philanthropist Gabe Newell, The Heart of Racing is a charity
additionalSources.note: Aston Martin's own announcement of the Valkyrie programme; also quotes Executive Chairman Lawrence Stroll thanking 'Gabe Newell and Heart of Racing for partnering with Aston Martin on this programme'.
